name: Layout engine
responsibility: Lays one graph out as Track or Blocks inside a layout worker
description: createLayoutEngine binds the initialized Graphviz and libavoid WebAssembly engines; a solve names its engine in archboard.stage and any other is refused. The host runs it in a worker pool: Bun Workers under Bun, Web Workers in a tab (layout-worker.ts). Engine coordinates are never authored or persisted (ADR 0023).
